title: Exam format
description: One element of content/<lang>/exam-formats.json, which is a JSON array. Describes a published exam as data so core-assessment can simulate it.

edition.description: Edition or Stand date of the provider document the figures were taken from, for example 2025-09-01.

total_minutes.description: Whole exam including speaking, when the provider states it. Excludes preparation time and breaks.

pass_mark.description: Fraction of max_points needed to pass. For modular exams this is the fraction per module.

modular.description: True when each section is passed, certified and repeatable on its own.

cost_eur.description: Published fee in euro as printed by the provider, or a short note when the provider does not publish one.

scoring_en.description: Scoring rule in plain words. Modular exams say so here.

source_url.description: Exact URL of the provider document the format level figures come from.

name.description: Section name as printed on the exam, for example Hören.

item_count.description: Number of scored items across the tasks, when known.

minutes.description: Time limit. When time_block is set, this is the length of the shared block and must be counted once per block.

time_block.description: Sections with the same time_block share one clock, for example telc Leseverstehen and Sprachbausteine.

preparation_minutes.description: Preparation time before the section starts, when the provider grants one.

task_types_en.description: Short description of each task in order.

source_url.description: Exact URL of the provider document these section figures come from.
